blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Pre-launch issuer-model review: RealFi's base-token and backing pages read by HTTP GET on 2026-10-28 at 09:52:06 UTC describe the entire external reserve as managed Treasury, money-market and credit claims. All declared reserve categories depend on off-chain issuer or custodian control, so the model implies 100% upstream exposure regardless of undisclosed allocation weights. This is structural documentation, not a measured current reserve balance or attestation. The AML/KYC framework does not independently establish a holder-transfer freeze on the Cardano native asset; no direct freeze power is asserted.
